pages.text: Press $(k:key.puffish_skills.open) for your talent trees. Kills earn talent experience, shared with party members within 200 blocks.$(br2)Kills fill the class tree up to 9 points. Four more come from the great bosses: The Harbinger, the Netherite Monstrosity, Ignis and the Ender Guardian.
Changed your mind? An $(item)Orb of Oblivion$() resets your talents so you can spend them again, or on another class tree.
